definitions.explanation: fish kept for decorative or hobby purposes rather than for food, including tropical fish, goldfish, and koi

examples.japanese: {観賞魚|かんしょうぎょ}を{飼|か}い{始|はじ}めた。
ペットショップの{観賞魚|かんしょうぎょ}コーナーで{熱帯魚|ねったいぎょ}を{選|えら}んだ。
examples.english: I chose tropical fish at the ornamental fish section of the pet shop.

examples.japanese: {観賞魚|かんしょうぎょ}の{水槽|すいそう}は{定期的|ていきてき}に{水|みず}を{替|か}えないと{魚|さかな}が{病気|びょうき}になる。
examples.english: If you don't change the water in an ornamental fish tank regularly, the fish will get sick.

notes:
Combines {観賞|かんしょう} (appreciation, viewing for enjoyment) and {魚|ぎょ} (fish). Japan has a long tradition of keeping ornamental fish, especially {金魚|きんぎょ} (goldfish) and {錦鯉|にしきごい} (koi), which date back centuries.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {観賞魚|かんしょうぎょ}を{飼|か}う: to keep ornamental fish
- {観賞魚|かんしょうぎょ}{専門店|せんもんてん}: ornamental fish specialty shop
- {観賞魚|かんしょうぎょ}の{水槽|すいそう}: ornamental fish tank
- {観賞魚|かんしょうぎょ}{用品|ようひん}: ornamental fish supplies

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {熱帯魚|ねったいぎょ}: tropical fish — a subcategory of ornamental fish from warm waters
- {金魚|きんぎょ}: goldfish — the most traditional ornamental fish in Japan
- {錦鯉|にしきごい}: ornamental koi — colorful carp kept in ponds
